item.title: Version 1.27.0
item.description:
New
- Video sharing platform — upload and share recordings directly from the app via share.debut.sh (DEBUT-117) - Browser frame mockups — wrap recordings in Safari, Chrome, or generic browser chrome for a polished look (DEBUT-130) - Hide notifications during recording to keep captures clean (DEBUT-146)
Improved
- Recording quality presets (Standard/High/Ultra) with configurable bitrate options (DEBUT-97) - Shared videos section in the dashboard for managing uploaded recordings
Fixed
- Ensure render completes fully before sharing to prevent incomplete uploads - Release script improvements
